## Physical scenario

The emf phasor in figure is shown at \( t = 15\,\text{ms} \).

## Question

What is the instantaneous value of the emf?

## Answer choices

- A: A: \( -6\

- B: B: \( -8\

- C: C: \( -10\

- D: D: \( -5\

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a phasor diagram. 

- It has a coordinate system with horizontal and vertical axes intersecting at the origin.
- A green arrow, representing the phasor, originates from the origin and points towards the top left quadrant.
- The arrow is labeled with \(\mathcal{E}_0 = 12 \, \text{V}\) at its beginning, indicating the magnitude of the phasor.
- The angle between the arrow and the positive horizontal axis is marked as \(30^\circ\).
- There is a text annotation, "Phasor at \(t = 15 \, \text{ms}\)," situated above the arrow, indicating the time at which this phasor is represented.
